sloka: ददुः च परम प्रीताः चतुरंग बलम् सुराः ।ततो भग्ना नृपतयो हन्यमाना दिशो ययुः ॥१-६६-२४॥
transliteration: daduḥ ca parama prītāḥ caturaṁga balam surāḥ ।tato bhagnā nṛpatayo hanyamānā diśo yayuḥ ॥1-66-24॥

translations.english: Then those wicked kings who were exhausted were doubtful about their energy. They were beaten and defeated. They fled away along with their ministers in different directions.
